meta.name: finance
meta.description: The finance domain's own rules beyond the reconciliation's engine (configs/reconcile.json): the duplicate invoice search (duplicates, read by jav/domains/finance/duplicates.py: the families of invoice-like types, a document compared only with the earlier ones of its own family and a pro forma invoice its own; the fields that name the invoice number and the supplier; the values compared to tell a copy from a modified version) and the reconciliation's bands (reconcile, read by jav/domains/finance/reconcile.py: a forint card line around the invoice amount converted at the MNB rate, a forint bank line per rate day, the quick review's sure AI kind; 231: the cap of the AI pairing proposal a person starts on a pairing case). All proposals only; a person decides.

changelog.note: 231 (plan stage C, C2c; the owner's decision of 2026-10-25, DECISIONS 231): reconcile.ai_proposal: the AI pairing proposal a person starts from a pairing case's page asks JEV only, at most 0.20 USD a run (max_run_usd); the GPT path is a separate decision. Kept out of the reconciliation's call site file, whose fingerprint is part of every stored JEV answer's key.

224 (plan G-process-core P3c, DECISIONS 218): moved unchanged from configs/policy.json 1.25.0 (its duplicates and reconcile sections), so a change to them no longer changes the shared rule file's fingerprint. Not into configs/reconcile.json: its fingerprint is printed on a reconciliation's statement, so moving them there would have shown every approved statement as changed. Earlier history: the policy.json changelog (1.18.0, 126: the duplicate search; 1.19.0, 130: reconcile.fx_tolerance; 1.20.0, 147: reconcile.ai_sure; 1.22.0, 149: reconcile.fx_bank_tolerance).
